d:
"Masoom is the story of a happy family that goes through turbulent times because of a hidden past. D.K. Malhotra’s domestic life is turned upside down when he discovers that he has an illegitimate child named Rahul from a past affair. Rahul is sent to live with his father when his mother dies. D.K. decides to admit Rahul in a boarding school in Nainital. Rahul discovers that D.K. is his biological father and runs away. Watch what happens when Rahul disappears from D.K.'s house and the impact it has on D.K.
YOR - 1983
